sloka: आङ्गेषु प्रथितो राजा भविष्यति महाबलः ।तस्य व्यतिक्रमात् राज्ञो भविष्यति सुदारुणा ॥१-९-८॥
transliteration: āṅgeṣu prathito rājā bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ।tasya vyatikramāt rājño bhaviṣyati sudāruṇā ॥1-9-8॥

translations.english: Because of violation of code of conduct by the king, a terrible, dreadful drought frightening all living beings will set in the kingdom.
